decisions.quote: To conclude, we failed to replicate the main result of DeLong et al., a landmark study published more than 10 years ago that has not been directly replicated since.
decisions.reason: The authors explicitly designate the replicated noun-cloze effect as a manipulation check and state an overall conclusion that they failed to replicate the main article-cloze result of DeLong et al. (2005), which under the codebook rules for overall verdicts and manipulation checks is coded as failed rather than mixed.
